Name: Eunoia's Farmyard - Chocobunnies - Rabbit Retexture and Rabbits Foot Replacer
Author: eunoiamods
Description:
[size=5][b]Eunoia's Farmyard - Chocobunnies[/b][/size]

Retextures and recolours Rabbits in a variety of chocolate-inspired flavours. Various options for changing the Rabbits Foot to suit your preferences!

[b]Please[/b] let me know if you have any problems or want to suggest new colours or features!

[i][b]Please[/b][b] don't[/b][/i] ask if I'm planning to make a version with a more muted colour palette or darker outlines. I like my shiny, bright style and I think some others do too! I appreciate you love the mod enough to want to use it in your game but there are many mods catering to that style, Try checking them out instead.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

- [b]Everything is modular. There are toggles and descriptions for all options.[/b]

- Rabbits come in 4 flavours - Dark Chocolate, Milk Chocolate, Caramilk Chocolate and White Chocolate. 

- The rabbits foot is retextured in a vanilla style and as a Chocolate Bunny.

- If you use the Chocolate Bunny rabbits foot replacer, the item has a new name and description.

- It will also be requested by a certain man in a van asking for a 'Chocolatey Treat'.

-  Rabbits can be renamed to 'Bunny', Chocobunny' or 'Chocolate Bunny'.

- The Rabbits foot/Chocolate Bunny can be made edible and has an optional luck and speed boost when eaten. (+1 luck and speed for 5 mins)

- Penny can love the Rabbits foot/Chocolate Bunny.

[b][size=4]Future Plans[/size][/b]

- Baby animal sprites.

- Other chocolate flavours. Maybe strawberry and lavender? Let me know in the comments.

- Do something with the retextured wool I made for each bunny.

[size=4][b]Troubleshooting[/b][/size]

When the mod is added to an existing save, the changes may fail to load properly. This can be fixed by changing the config to a different option and back again. Any other problems, let me know!
